articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: SOXX and SMH ETFs Sink, But Barclays Stays Bullish on Semiconductor Stocks
articles.summary: SOXX and SMH ETFs have dropped sharply in the past few days, but analysts at UBS and Barclays believe that semiconductor stocks will rebound.
articles._summary: Semiconductor stocks have pulled back sharply as investors remain concerned about tapering demand and a pullback in capital expenditure. Despite the recent pullback, American investors have remained bullish on semiconductor stocks. Data from ETFdb shows that the SOXX has attracted more than $5.1 billion in inflows over the past 30 days and $12 billion over the last six months. Meanwhile, the SMH has recorded inflows of $2.03 billion and $6.36 billion over the same periods, respectively.
articles._zh_headline: SOXX 和 SMH ETF 下跌，但巴克莱仍看好半导体股票
articles._zh_summary: 由于投资者仍然担心需求减少和资本支出缩减，半导体股票大幅回落。尽管最近出现回调，美国投资者仍然看好半导体股票。 ETFdb 的数据显示，SOXX 在过去 30 天吸引了超过 51 亿美元的资金流入，在过去 6 个月吸引了 120 亿美元的资金流入。与此同时，SMH 同期的流入资金分别为 20.3 亿美元和 63.6 亿美元。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Ross Gerber Says Apple Should Buy Disney or 'Stop Wasting Time' in Entertainment
articles.summary: Gerber urged Apple to buy Disney or exit entertainment, reviving Apple-Disney merger speculation as Disney's stock continues to struggle.
articles._summary: Gerber, CEO of Gerber Kawasaki , argued that Apple has reached a crossroads in its entertainment strategy, saying the tech giant should either fully commit by acquiring Disney or stop investing in the business. In a post on X , Gerber wrote, “Now is the time for Apple to decide if they really want to be in the entertainment business. Because if they took out Disney it would become the ultimate consumer company… Apple Disney… otherwise Apple should stop wasting time in entertainment.”
articles._zh_headline: 罗斯·格伯表示苹果应该收购迪士尼或“停止在娱乐领域浪费时间”
articles._zh_summary: 格柏川崎首席执行官格柏认为，苹果的娱乐战略已经走到了十字路口，他表示，这家科技巨头要么完全致力于收购迪士尼，要么停止对该业务的投资。格伯在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道，“现在是苹果决定他们是否真的想涉足娱乐业务的时候了。因为如果他们打败迪士尼，它将成为最终的消费公司……苹果迪士尼……否则苹果应该停止在娱乐领域浪费时间。”

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Tesla Stock in Focus as It Expands German Production Ahead of Earnings
articles.summary: Tesla stock has landed at a crucial support level as the company expands its German manufacturing ahead of its earnings report
articles._summary: Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA ) stock will be in focus this week as the electric vehicle giant reports its financial results. The shares have fallen nearly 25% to around $380 after peaking at almost $500 in December last year. Tesla’s business is doing relatively well even as its stock remains in a bear market. Its recently released delivery numbers showed that it returned to growth in the second quarter. The company delivered 480,126 vehicles in the quarter after producing 451,758 vehicles.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉股票成为焦点，因为它在盈利前扩大了德国产量
articles._zh_summary: 特斯拉（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）股票本周将成为焦点，因为这家电动汽车巨头将公布其财务业绩。自去年 12 月达到近 500 美元的峰值后，该股已下跌近 25% 至 380 美元左右。尽管特斯拉的股票仍处于熊市，但其业务表现相对较好。其最近公布的交付数据显示，第二季度恢复增长。该公司本季度生产了 451,758 辆汽车，交付了 480,126 辆汽车。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Intel Stock Forms an Alarming Pattern as Earnings Loom
articles.summary: Intel stock has formed a double-top pattern pointing to more downside as its earnings loom on Thursday this week
articles._summary: Intel is still one of the best-performing companies in the United States this year. It has jumped by 150% since January and by 320% in the last 12 months, with its valuation soaring to over $477 billion. Intel is also benefiting from the ongoing AI agent growth, which has led to a surge in demand for CPUs . The most recent results showed that its revenue jumped by 7% to $13.6 billion, while its gross margin rose to 39.4%. It also reduced its R&D and MG&A costs by 8%.
articles._zh_headline: 随着盈利的临近，英特尔股票形成令人担忧的格局
articles._zh_summary: 英特尔仍然是今年美国表现最好的公司之一。自 1 月份以来，该公司股价上涨了 150%，过去 12 个月上涨了 320%，估值飙升至超过 4770 亿美元。英特尔还受益于 AI 代理的持续增长，这导致 CPU 需求激增。最新业绩显示，其收入增长 7%，达到 136 亿美元，毛利率升至 39.4%。它还将研发和管理与管理成本降低了 8%。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: SpaceX Has Fallen 45% Since Its Peak: Gary Black Says Investors Are Breaking the 'Number One Rule in Investing'
articles.summary: Gary Black says investors are breaking the "number one rule in investing" by treating SpaceX as a great stock, not just a great business.
articles._summary: He said SpaceX’s roughly $1.7 trillion market capitalization “shouldn’t mathematically” command a forward enterprise value-to-revenue multiple of about 40 times, calling it a valuation with no historical precedent among trillion-dollar companies. According to the response, NVIDIA’s trailing EV-to-revenue multiple briefly approached 45 times. Still, its forward multiple generally remained between 10 and 25 times as revenue growth accelerated.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX自巅峰以来已下跌45%：加里·布莱克称投资者正在打破“投资第一规则”
articles._zh_summary: 他表示，SpaceX 约 1.7 万亿美元的市值“从数学上讲”不应要求其远期企业价值与收入倍数约为 40 倍，称其估值在万亿美元公司中没有历史先例。根据回应，NVIDIA 的落后 EV 与收入倍数短暂接近 45 倍。尽管如此，随着收入增长加速，其远期市盈率普遍保持在 10 至 25 倍之间。
